finding: An Elpi command can read its own source text, so removing comments can identify texts whose execution defines different constants.
classification: Covered by prohibition of the execution mechanism; no Elpi source-reading payload is executed here.
mechanism: Before compilation, scripts/check_sources.py forbids every command whose normalized head is Elpi. It also rejects all Rocq control prefixes, so a prefix cannot hide that command. Extra Dependency is independently prohibited.

covered_by.coverage: Elpi Command is crossed with every supported control-prefix form, including named Profile; both the control and the inner Elpi head must be reported.
Existing before-build regression for an Elpi program supplied through Extra Dependency; rejects Elpi/Extra Dependency before the marker-producing program executes.

why_no_own_source_payload: The source-reading behavior is unavailable if the Elpi command cannot compile. The generic command-head ban covers all Elpi command arguments, including a program that reads its source; replaying that program adds no distinct protection test.
limits: This is explicit coverage by tested mechanisms, not a claimed separate E34 end-to-end execution or a claim that comment stripping preserves arbitrary plugin side effects.
